what_results_support: Q0 prerequisite evidence: non-degenerate actual-path OOF utility, expert/modality diversity, positive Oracle-minus-fixed and one-shot read-only action transfer.
what_results_dont_support: Q1 reliable policy learning, final refit, frozen dev performance, deployment gain, official performance, SOTA, ablations or representation generalization.
missing_evidence: strict wins over exact Signal, V8 Phase-B and fixed experts
suggested_claim_revision: V13 qualifies an actual-path OOF utility target, but its deployment-feature Router does not reliably learn that target or improve OOF replay.
next_experiments_needed: Stop V13. A successor requires a new preregistered train-only policy-generalization hypothesis; no V13 hyperparameter scans or dev access.
